name: @pointyink/rogue
description: State-of-the-art HTML sync CRDT engine (Fugue CRDT + rope treap) with a DOM sync layer.

scripts.build:wasm: zig build wasm -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && node scripts/emit-wasm.mjs && node scripts/emit-wasm-u8.mjs
scripts.build:dist: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.js src/sync.js src/dom_rope.js src/comments.js src/suggestions.js src/editor-session.js src/crdt_error.js src/replica.js src/checkpoint.js src/rogue_text.js src/oplog.js src/sync-client.js src/doc-cache.js src/doc-bus.js src/headless.js src/rogue.wasm.js --minify --outdir=dist --format=esm --platform=neutral
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:dist && npm run build:types
